# Wizhy Web Studio (WWS)

> Premium bespoke web design, lightning-fast web development, and technical SEO agency. Guaranteed 100/100 Google PageSpeed score, zero layout shift (0 CLS), and sub-second Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).

## About Wizhy Web Studio
Wizhy Web Studio (WWS) designs, engineers, and scales high-performance digital experiences for modern businesses, e-commerce brands, and startups worldwide. Every project is built from scratch with zero template bloat, bespoke UX architecture, and technical SEO natively engineered into every line of code.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Bespoke UI/UX Design**: Modern, responsive design with micro-interactions, dark/light/espresso themes, and mobile-first typography.
- **Technical SEO & Structured Data**: Native Schema.org (ProfessionalService, FAQPage, Service, AggregateRating), semantic HTML5, zero render blocking, automatic sitemaps.
- **Core Web Vitals Engineering**: Sub-second FCP/LCP, 0.000 CLS, <20ms TBT, HTTP/3, and Brotli compression.
- **Custom Integrations**: Payment gateways, AI Assistant widgets, automated lead pipelines via Telegram/Email alerts.

Wizhy Web Studio features an embedded AI assistant, **WizAI**, accessible on the website for instant quotes, package recommendations, and FAQ handling.
